basic_details.job_title: CTIL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Young Professionals, Associates and Consultants Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Centre for Trade and Investment Law

age_limit.age_details: Max age varies from 28 to 50 years depending on the post
age_limit.details: Young Professional (without prior experience): Maximum age limit is 28 years. Young Professional (with prior experience): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Associate: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Consultant: Maximum age limit is 50 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in law, economics, international law, public policy, data science, cost accounting or related discipline (or Bachelor's Degree in Law / Master's degree for specific Young Professional category)
qualification.details: Young Professional (without prior experience): Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB.) or a Masters' degree in economics, diplomacy, international relations, public policy, data science, general management, cost accounting or a related discipline from a top NIRF or recognized World University Ranking institution. Prior work experience is not a requirement. Young Professional (with prior experience): Master’s degree in economics, law, international Law, public policy, data science, cost accounting or a related discipline with at least 55%. Minimum of 1-year post-qualification experience. Associate: Master’s degree in economics, law, international Law, public policy, data science, cost accounting or a related discipline with at least 55%. Minimum of 3 years post-qualification experience, out of which a minimum of 1 year must be in the relevant field. Consultant (with/without PhD): Master’s degree in economics, law, international law, public policy, data science, cost accounting or a related discipline with at least 55%. Minimum of 8 years post-qualification experience, out of which a minimum of 3 years must be in the relevant field.

salary_details.consultant: ₹ 1,45,000- 2,65,000 for PhD candidates and ₹ 1,37,500- 2,65,000 for without PhD candidates

selection_process: Shortlisting based on application Written test Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CTIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CTIL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Centre for Trade and Investment Law (CTIL) for hiring qualified professionals across various contractual research designations.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CTIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for Young Professionals, Associates, and Consultants positions under advertisement number CRITES-11013/5/2026-CTIL.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CTIL posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the CTIL recruitment is 09 October 2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Young Professionals?
faq.answer: The salary for Young Professionals ranges from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 60,000/- per month depending on whether they possess prior post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master's degree in law, economics, international law, public policy, data science, cost accounting or related disciplines, or a Bachelor's Degree in Law for specific posts.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification released by the Centre for Trade and Investment Law for these contractual positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications, a written test, and a personal interview conducted by the competent authority at CTIL.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for CTIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in New Delhi, operating under the Centre for Trade and Investment Law framework across India.

faq.question: Q9. Can freshers apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers who hold a Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) or a recognized Master's degree can apply for the Young Professional position without prior experience.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for CTIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website docs.iift.ac.in or by clicking the direct application link provided in the important links section.
